HomePage.faq1Question: How can I join as a volunteer?
HomePage.faq1Answer: You can register through our website by filling out the volunteer form. You will then receive a message with the next steps and initial orientation details.
HomePage.faq2Question: Is volunteering with the Gözbebekleri team paid?
HomePage.faq2Answer: No, volunteering is generally unpaid. In some programs, active volunteers may receive transportation support or appreciation rewards.
HomePage.faq3Question: How are volunteers selected for projects?
HomePage.faq3Answer: Selection depends on factors such as skills, location, and availability. We try to match each volunteer with the most suitable opportunity.
HomePage.faq4Answer: Yes. We have digital volunteering opportunities in areas such as content management, graphic design, digital marketing, and communication with supporters.
HomePage.faq5Question: How can I suggest my own initiative?
HomePage.faq5Answer: If you have an idea for a humanitarian project, the Gözbebekleri team can help you bring it to life by providing resources and logistical support.

AboutUs.associationName: Qurrat Al-Ayun Relief and Solidarity Association
AboutUs.aboutUsDesc1: We are a Turkish relief and solidarity association working in child care and child support around the world. We strive to provide children with a better life and a safer future, ease their suffering, support their access to basic rights, and help develop their mental and physical abilities.
AboutUs.aboutUsDesc2: We also work to integrate children in need into society, raise their awareness of their rights, and improve the social, economic, and psychological conditions of their families through meaningful, high-quality programs and projects.
AboutUs.visionQuote: To make a real difference in the world of childhood and contribute to raising a productive generation that benefits itself and its community.
AboutUs.goalsTitle: The Goals We Strive to Achieve
AboutUs.goalsDesc: We work to achieve humanitarian, social, and educational goals that serve children, their families, and society.
AboutUs.presidentTitle: A Message from the Association President
AboutUs.ctaDesc: Join us on our journey to build a better future for children around the world.
goalsList: To provide quality services for children and their families in living support, healthcare, psychological support, and education.
To raise generations capable of developing themselves, facing challenges, and building strong personalities.
To discover children's skills, support their creativity, and develop their abilities and talents.
To protect children from all forms of exploitation and neglect, and to strengthen their awareness of their rights.
To contribute to raising generations built on strong values and solid moral principles.
To support sustainable systems in education, training, care, and healthcare services.
To help children reach a brighter, safer, and more hopeful future.
presidentMessageParagraphs: In today's world, especially in regions affected by crises, children are among the groups most affected by conflict, economic hardship, wars, and natural disasters.

In the face of this painful reality, we refused to remain mere spectators. Instead, we took action to help build a safer, more hopeful, and more dignified future for every child we can reach, especially orphaned children.
Since 2011, Gözbebekleri Association has carried out various projects to support children in need and orphans, particularly in healthcare, education, nutrition, and social support.

When it comes to children, our guide and example is Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, who was sent as a mercy to all worlds. We seek to follow his compassion toward children by easing their pain, meeting their needs, and bringing hope to their lives.

Through our specialized teams and volunteers in different regions, we work to make children feel that they are not alone. We strive to touch their lives, improve their conditions, and open new doors of hope before them.

Our association continues its work without any profit motive, guided by the principle: "Serving people is serving Allah." With sincerity, responsibility, and through your support and trust, we continue delivering goodness to those who need it most.
